name: Siberian
allergenNote: Some allergic owners tolerate Siberians better, and limited evidence suggests certain individual cats produce less Fel d 1. Levels vary widely between cats, so spend time with the specific cat first.

name: Russian Blue
allergenNote: Often described as better tolerated by allergic people, but this is mostly anecdotal. Russian Blues still produce Fel d 1.

name: Devon Rex
allergenNote: Sheds less hair than many breeds, but less hair does not mean less Fel d 1, which comes from saliva and skin glands. Reports of better tolerance are mostly anecdotal.

name: Sphynx
allergenNote: Hairlessness does not make a cat allergen-free. Fel d 1 is produced in saliva and skin glands and can build up on skin oils, which is why Sphynx cats need regular bathing.
